description:
Tap Kilo using any free method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and putting a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

uses.name: Pentad Prism
uses.cardState: with a charge counter on it
